comment: Hand-written one-liners: one per block in grammar/blocks.json, plus words the tables miss — 4.0 statements and literals, colour built-ins, and top-level scene blocks. Everything else is mined into descriptions.json by tools/language/reference.mjs --generate. This file is the curated part; it may be edited.

blocks.bicubic_patch: Bezier patch surface from a 4x4 control-point grid.
blocks.box: Box from two opposite corner vectors.
blocks.cone: Cone or frustum from two end points and radii; open removes the caps.
blocks.cubic: Third-degree polynomial shape; a special case of poly.
blocks.cylinder: Cylinder from two end points and one radius; open removes the caps.
blocks.disc: Infinitely thin flat disc: center, normal, outer radius, optional inner radius.
blocks.height_field: Triangle mesh whose heights come from an image's brightness.
blocks.isosurface_mesh: Isosurface tessellated into a mesh2 at parse time, sharp edges exact.
blocks.lemon: Cone-like shape whose side is an arc of Inner_Radius; end radii may be zero.
blocks.mesh: One object collecting explicit triangle components.
blocks.ovus: Egg shape from bottom and top radius, with radius, distance and precision controls.
blocks.parametric: Surface from three functions of u and v; precompute caches its mesh.
blocks.plane: Infinite solid half-space from a surface normal and a distance.
blocks.poly: Polynomial surface up to seventh degree from numbered coefficients.
blocks.polygon: Flat shape from a loop of 2-D points, with optional hole loops.
blocks.polynomial: Poly with named coefficients in any order; omitted coefficients default to 0.
blocks.prism: Solid swept from closed 2-D curves in the x-z plane along y.
blocks.quadric: Second-degree polynomial surface from ten coefficients.
blocks.quartic: Fourth-degree polynomial surface from thirty-five coefficients.
blocks.smooth_triangle: Triangle carrying per-vertex normals for smooth shading.
blocks.sor: Surface of revolution: a curve of points spun about the y axis.
blocks.sphere: Sphere from a center and a radius.
blocks.superellipsoid: Superquadric shape, rounded box to pinched cylinder, from two exponents.
blocks.text: TrueType font rendered as geometry, with thickness and offset.
blocks.torus: Ring in the x-z plane from major and minor radii.
blocks.triangle: Flat triangle from three corner points.
blocks.composite: Legacy CSG grouping from before union; still parsed.
blocks.difference: CSG: first child minus every following child.
blocks.light_group: Objects lit only by the lights named inside it.
blocks.merge: CSG union that removes inner surfaces, for transparent children.
blocks.union: CSG: children grouped as one object.
blocks.sphere_sweep: Tube of varying radius sweeping a spline of sphere centers.
blocks.lathe: Solid of revolution: a 2-D profile curve spun about y.
blocks.blob: Metaball surface from sphere and cylinder strength components.
blocks.mesh2: Mesh in structured lists: vertex_vectors, normal_vectors, face_indices.
blocks.julia_fractal: 3-D slice of a 4-D quaternion Julia set.
blocks.isosurface: Implicit surface where f(x,y,z) is zero, solved while rendering.
blocks.portal: Rays entering its body continue from the mapped point elsewhere.
blocks.finish: How the surface reflects: highlights, reflection, ambient, brilliance.
blocks.texture: One material layer: pigment, normal, finish and transformations.
blocks.material: texture with interior and interior_texture grouped together.
blocks.pigment: Surface colour: a pattern, colour map or image map.
blocks.normal: Perturbed surface normals: bump pattern, bump map, slope.
blocks.density: Pattern block scaling media density across its container.
blocks.interior: Inside-the-surface properties: ior, caustics, fading, media.
blocks.media: Participating medium: scattering, emission, absorption, intervals; its light_source is a volume light, not a scene light.
blocks.camera: The eye: location, direction, projection type, lens effects.
blocks.global_settings: Renderer-wide scene options: radiosity, photons, gamma, tracing depth.
blocks.object: Copies or wraps an already-declared object with new modifiers.
blocks.light_source: A light: position, colour, area, shadowing and photon options.
blocks.image_map: Pigment pattern wrapping a 2-D image file around the object.
blocks.bump_map: Normal perturbation pattern wrapping a 2-D image file.

quality.text: Progressive photon budget for photons { method 2 quality FLOAT }; finite, positive and at most 16384, default 1. Contextual: remains available as an identifier.

let.text: Binds a name in the current function scope; repeats rebind.

global.text: Binds a name at file scope: global X = E; visible in the file's functions and included files.

fn.text: Defines a named function; shorthand for a let-bound lambda.

return.text: Ends the function with a value; error after items were emitted.

if.text: Runs its body when the condition is true; else supplies the alternative.

else.text: The alternative arm of an if: else { ... } or else if (C) { ... }.

while.text: Repeats its body while the condition holds.

for.text: for (I = A to B) counts inclusively, step S optional; for (V in A) iterates an array, dictionary keys or a fragment.

include.text: include "file.inc4"; runs another file in the including file's scope.

null.text: The empty value; let X; binds X as null.

in.text: for (V in A) iterates an array, dictionary keys or fragment.

step.text: for (I = A to B step S) sets the increment; default 1.

rgb.text: Colour from a vector or one grey level: rgb <1, 0, 0>, rgb 0.5.

rgbf.text: Colour with a filter value appended: rgbf <r, g, b, f>.

rgbt.text: Colour with a transmit value appended: rgbt <r, g, b, t>.

rgbft.text: Colour with filter and transmit values appended: rgbft <r, g, b, f, t>.

srgb.text: Colour taken from the sRGB space and converted to linear rgb.

color.text: Optional head of a colour value: color rgb <1, 0, 0>, color Red; spelled colour too.

colour.text: Optional head of a colour value: colour rgb <1, 0, 0>, colour Red; spelled color too.

background.text: The colour or pigment shown behind every object.

sky_sphere.text: A pigment wrapped on a huge sphere around the scene to suggest a sky.

fog.text: Fades distant objects toward a colour; fog_type picks flat fog or ground mist.

rainbow.text: An arc of colour bands across the sky: direction, angle, width, distance.

default.text: Item values every later object begins from: default { texture { ... } }.

prepared_media_cells.text: Cell limit for a medium's prepared density grid; grids coarsen to fit, and a warning names the fitted resolution.

atmospheric_dispersion.text: Wavelength-dependent spread of the atmosphere's refraction.

mesh_cache.text: Directory where finished isosurface_mesh and skein_mesh meshes are kept between renders.

interface_texture.text: Texture of the interface where coincident media surfaces merge: the average of its objects' textures.

max_angle.text: Degrees the gradient may turn across a cube before isosurface_mesh splits it; smaller follows curves more closely.

min_size.text: Smallest cube isosurface_mesh will split, in object units; thinner detail is missed.

len.text: Element count of an array or string; key count of a dictionary.

range.text: Inclusive array from A to B stepping S (default 1).

map.text: New array with F applied to every element.

filter.text: New array keeping elements where F(P) is true.

push.text: New array with V appended; arrays have fixed size.

defined.text: False while the name is unbound or null.

debug.text: Writes S to the debug output stream.

warning.text: Writes S to the warning stream.

error.text: Writes S to the error stream and aborts.

array.text: New N-element array, every element Fill (default null).
